text:
Avatar: The Last Airbender won an Annie Award for Storyboarding in an Animated Television Production for the episode "The Deserter," which matches the team note, though I couldn't confirm the 2006 ceremony year from an official Annie Awards source. Sources disagree on the winner: Wikipedia's storyboarding table lists Lauren MacMullan, while [IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/es/name/nm0534041/awards) credits Zach Tyler Eisen, and I found no annieawards.org record to settle it. My earlier answer missed this because I had searched for wins and nominations, not storyboarding.

CONFIDENCE: 55
